title: models/trip
description: A trip represents a journey taken by a _mobility as a service_ customer with a geo-tagged start and stop point.

provider_id.description: A UUID for the Provider, unique within MDS. See MDS [provider list](https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/main/providers.csv).

data_provider_id.description: If different than `provider_id`, a UUID for the data solution provider managing the data feed in this endpoint.

device_id.description: A unique device ID in UUID format.

trip_id.description: A unique ID for each trip

start_location.description: Location of the start of the trip.

end_location.description: Location of the end of the trip.

publication_time.description: Date/time that trip became available through the trips endpoint.

parking_verification_url.description: A URL to a photo (or other evidence) of proper vehicle parking at the end of a trip, provided by customer or operator.

parking_category.description:
The type of parking location detected or provided and the end of a trip. Note that `other_valid` covers any other
allowed parking location beyond what is enumerated, and `invalid` is any improper parking based on agency parking rules.

standard_cost.description: The cost, in the currency defined in `currency`, that it would cost to perform that trip in the standard operation of the System.

actual_cost.description: The actual cost, in the currency defined in `currency`, paid by the customer of the _mobility as a service_ provider.

data-types_currency.title: data-types/currency
data-types_currency.description: An [ISO 4217 Alphabetic Currency Code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217#Active_codes) representing currency of the payee. If null, USD cents is implied.

data-types_currency-cost.title: data-types/currency-cost
data-types_currency-cost.description: Represents an optional cost defined in a [`currency`](./currency.yaml).

altitude.description: Altitude above mean sea level in meters.

heading.description: Degrees - clockwise starting at 0 degrees at true North.

satellites.description: Number of GPS or GNSS satellites.

speed.description: Estimated speed in meters / sec as reported by the GPS chipset.

data-types_integer-positive.title: data-types/integer-positive
data-types_integer-positive.description: An integer greater than or equal to 0.

data-types_uuid.title: data-types/uuid
data-types_uuid.description: A UUID used to uniquely identity an object.

modes_car-share_accessibility-attributes.title: modes/car-share/accessibility-attributes
modes_car-share_accessibility-attributes.description: Accessibility options definition for the `car-share` mode.

journey_id.description:
A unique journey ID for associating collections of trips. The journey_id field shall have a consistent value in
overlapping trips for a single reservation period, e.g. trips taken by a customer between ignition states over the
duration of their reservation. A reservation is the duration the customer has continuous exclusive access to the vehicle
whether parked or in motion. Journeys may be point-to-point or multi-segment.

reservation_id.description: A unique identifier for an entire car share reservation, tied across multiple journeys and therefore trips.

app_name.description: Name of the app used to reserve the trip which could be provider's app or 3rd party app.

permit_license_number.description: The permit license number of the organization that dispatched the vehicle.

driver_id.description: Universal identifier of a specific driver, static across operators, like a driver's license number, for company employees in `reservation` or `empty` trip types, not `private` trips. Could also be used as a lookup in an agency's internal driver system.

fare_type.description: Indicator of which rate was charged.

tolls.description: Sum of any and all tolls charged for the trip, such as bridge tolls.

base_rate.description: Minimum fare to be charged as soon as the trip starts.

exit_fee.description: Fee to exit location, like an airport.

other_fees.description: Amount of any fees charged to the customer. Includes baggage fees, cleaning fee. Excludes other fees returned.

tip.description: Amount of tip paid by customer.

extra_amount.description: Miscellaneous extra amounts charged to customer not covered by other fields.

taxes.description: Amount of taxes paid for the ride.

accessibility_attributes.description: The accessibility options utilized for a given trip. Required if available.

modes_delivery-robots_accessibility-attr.title: modes/delivery-robots/accessibility-attributes
modes_delivery-robots_accessibility-attr.description: Accessibility options definition for the `delivery-robots` mode.

audio_cue.description: Is the device equipped with audio cues upon delivery.

visual_cue.description: Is the device equipped with visual cues upon delivery.

remote_open.description: Can the device door be remotely opened to retrieve cargo upon delivery.

journey_id.description:
The `journey_id` field shall have a consistent value in overlapping trips. Journeys may be point-to-point, multi-segment,
or multi-segment overlapping.

driver_id.description: Consistent unique identifier of the primary driver. Could be based on software version or an internal human driver id.

app_name.description: Name of the app used to reserve the trip which could be provider's app or 3rd party app.

requested_time.description: When the customer requested the trip.

has_payload.description: is there any payload for any delivery included in the device at trip start.

accessibility_attributes.description: The accessibility options available on a given delivery robot device. Required if available.

modes_micromobility_accessibility-attrib.title: modes/micromobility/accessibility-attributes
modes_micromobility_accessibility-attrib.description: Accessibility options definition for the `micromobility` mode.

accessibility_attributes.description: The accessibility options utilized for a given trip. Required if available.

modes_passenger-services_accessibility-a.title: modes/passenger-services/accessibility-attributes
modes_passenger-services_accessibility-a.description: Accessibility options definition for the `passenger-services` mode.

journey_id.description:
A unique journey ID for associating collections of trips. The `journey_id` field shall have a consistent value in
overlapping trips, e.g. "pooled" or "shared" rides with different start and/or end locations. Journeys may be
point-to-point, multi-segment, or multi-segment overlapping.

shift_id.description: A unique identifier for an entire driver's work shift, tied across multiple journeys and therefore trips.

app_name.description: Name of the app used to reserve the trip which could be provider's app or 3rd party app.

passenger_count.description: Unique count of passengers transported during trip duration.

requested_time.description: When the customer requested the trip.

requested_trip_start_location.description: Location where the customer requested the trip to start (required if this is within jurisdictional boundaries).

quoted_trip_start_time.description: Time the trip was estimated or scheduled to start, that was provided to the passenger.

dispatch_time.description: Time the vehicle was dispatched to the customer (required if trip was dispatched).

trip_wait_time.description: (milliseconds) Part of the passenger trip where the vehicle was moving slow or stopped (e.g. <12mph), which is a different fare rate in some jurisdictions.

trip_fare_time.description: (milliseconds) part of the passenger trip where the vehicle was moving more quickly (e.g. >12mph), which is a different fare rate in some jurisdictions.

pickup_address.description: Street address where the trip originated from.

dropoff_address.description: Street address where the trip ended.

permit_license_number.description: The permit license number of the organization that dispatched the vehicle.

driver_id.description: Universal identifier of a specific driver, static across operators, like a driver's license number. Could also be used as a lookup in an agency's internal driver system.

wheelchair_transported.description: is there any payload for any delivery included in the device at trip start.

cancellation_reason.description: The reason why a _driver_ cancelled a reservation. (required if a driver cancelled a trip, and a `driver_cancellation` event_type was part of the trip)

fare_type.description: Indicator of which rate was charged.

meter_fare_amount.description: If `upfront_pricing` is used as a `fare_type` include what the metered fare would have been if `meter_fare` would have been used. Allows cost comparison in evaluation of programs and pilots.

tolls.description: Sum of any and all tolls charged for the trip, such as bridge tolls.

base_rate.description: Minimum fare to be charged as soon as the trip starts.

exit_fee.description: Fee to exit location, like an airport.

other_fees.description: Amount of any fees charged to the customer. Includes baggage fees, cleaning fee. Excludes other fees returned.

tip.description: Amount of tip paid by customer.

extra_amount.description: Miscellaneous extra amounts charged to customer not covered by other fields.

taxes.description: Amount of taxes paid for the ride.

commission.description: Any extra commission for the ride.

driver_trip_pay.description: The payment the driver received for the trip.

accessibility_attributes.description: The accessibility options utilized for a given trip. Required if available.
